title: Hypothesis Evaluation Event
description: A directed, typed belief-update event testing an existing hypothesis (target_hypothesis_id) against reproducible measurements, primary-source collisions, cross-session audits, or boundary thought experiments. Used by tools/belief_state.py to compute posterior hypothesis distributions P_t(H|Q), epistemic uncertainty, and mass transfer from refuted/narrowed parents to scoped child hypotheses.

evaluation_id.description: Collision-resistant ID minted via tools/new_id.py EVL (EVL-YYYYMMDD-xxxxxx).

compared_against_hypothesis_ids.description: Competing hypotheses tested alongside target_hypothesis_id to prevent single-hypothesis confirmation bias.

spawned_hypothesis_ids.description: Scoped or synthesized child hypotheses receiving probability mass when verdict is narrows_scope, refutes_unconditioned, or subsumes.

script_command.description: Optional reproducible command verifying a measured verdict.
